reason: Round-one readers exposed ambiguous exactness, conflation of evidence mode with value generation, and inferred normalization hidden in free text.
unchanged: Keep the top-level structure, source fingerprints, coverage, objects, groups, assertions, exact evidence anchors, reported_value, reported_unit, normalization_basis, uncertainty, conditions, limitations and gaps from format.json.

meaning.evidence_mode: What kind of evidence the authors used; an experimentally fitted parameter remains experimental, not a generic mode called fit.
meaning.value_generation: How this quantity was obtained in the source. This pilot copies source reports; it does not run its own fits or calculations. Use not_established when the inspected method does not settle the distinction.
meaning.source_attribution: Distinguish authors' own work from numbers attributed to another study.
meaning.value_form: A reported measured value is a point estimate, not mathematically exact. Keep approximation and bound wording separately from uncertainty.
meaning.normalization_status: Whether denominator meaning is explicitly stated, inferred across contexts, unresolved, or genuinely inapplicable. A fractional yield/efficiency also has a denominator and is not automatically not_applicable.
meaning.measurand_status: Allows an interpretation such as capacitance proxy instead of silently changing the source's ECSA label. Explicit does not imply scientific validation.

revision_policy.source: Use the same immutable packets; inspect additional source chunks if needed and update the coverage record honestly.
revision_policy.numeric_policy: Do not alter reported numbers just to reconcile conflicting source passages. Preserve alternatives and mark the ambiguity.
revision_policy.review: Record a revision_notes array explaining semantic changes, especially if any value/context link was removed or narrowed. All outputs remain proposed.
